name: Maeda Itsuki
source:
Itsuki is a tomboy who has passion in sports, especially soccer. She is in Kirameki girl soccer club and is the best player in the team. She is always seen dribbling a soccer ball. Her closet friend is [url=http://vndb.org/c1691]Miyako[/url].

Besides athletic skills, Itsuki is also good at mechanics, as it is related to her family's business.

Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokimeki_Memorial_4] Wikipedia.[/url]
